note: Head coach per team per season, entered by hand: CollegeBasketballData.com 1.30.1 has no coaches endpoint. T0 observations, each with its source URL(s) and when it was entered. A team with no record here is UNKNOWN, never 'same coach'. Fields: season (END year), team_id (CBBD team id), team_name, coach, first_season_at_school (END year of his first season there), prior_job {team_name, level D1|D2|D3|NAIA|JUCO|NBA|G_LEAGUE|INTERNATIONAL|HIGH_SCHOOL|NONE, role HEAD|ASSOCIATE_HEAD|ASSISTANT|OTHER, internal_promotion}, career [{team_name, team_id?, level, role, from_season, to_season|null}], source_urls [https...], confidence confirmed|reported, entered_by, entered_at (UTC). Validated by basketball/ncaam_early/manual.js. Priority: the 2026-27 (2027) coaching changes; earlier seasons are incomplete and say so.
